Faceless God — Innate Technique (3rd level)

At 3rd level, you learn to directly inject madness into a creature. Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a melee attack while your technique is active, they gain a 5% increase to Mental Corruption. You can spend additional cursed energy up to your proficiency bonus on a hit to increase Mental Corruption by 5% per cursed energy spent.
